137304: A peculiar high school student that has basic training as a ninja and the unfound ability to speak to animals. Jirou Azuma, the grandson of Toshimasa Azuma, is a cocky kid with a heart for animals.
137545: The Black Sun, a legendary mononoke that has lived for over a millennia, renowned for raw power beyond any other: Ragou. Taking the form of an adorable pure black cat, Ragou may seem to not be much, though he very much is.
137546: Initially, Ichika may come off as cold and harsh to others, especially mononoke, though she will warm up to others overtime. When she first meets Jirou Azuma, she doesn't like him for his fused mononoke state with Ragou. Later, the three form a friendly bond.
137547: Ryousuke is the Chief of Special Operations Division 2 in the Bureau of Espionage. He is the founder of the special operations espionage squad, Black Torch.
138903: A friendly mononoke that works with the Bureau. Fuyou is capable of making illusions to trick others. She is a tad arrogant to those under her.
138904: A subordinate of Ryousuke. Is the assistant chief of special operations division 2. She has a bit of a quirky personality, but takes her job seriously, for the most part.
138905: Growing up, Shinji was a nice kid that cared for his brother immensely. One time, he cut Reiji while they were dueling and he immediately went to see if he was okay. Whenever he was praised, he was very thankful and excited as well.
138906: A powerful mononoke that has history with Ragou. Kouga is capable of impressive feats through his abilities. He has a snarky personality, like Jirou, but can get upset if things don't go his way. He also hates humans, but respects mononoke.
138907: The late mother of Ichika Kishimojin. In the past, Kanade had worked for the Bureau in fighting mononoke. While Ichika was a child, her mother was sent on a mission. The mission ended badly, as Kanade was turned to stone by a mononoke.
138908: Compared to other members of the Black Torch elite squad, Reiji presents himself to be much more calm and collected, rarely letting other emotions get the best of him.
138909: The chief of special operations division 1. Touko sports a somewhat harsh personality.
146835: The Kishimojin family maid. Not much is known about Nishina, though she took care of Ichika after her parents disappeared. Later, she showed Ichika her mother, who had been turned into a statue.
146836: A mononoke that follows Amagi's cause, Naruko is stranger than the average mononoke. The extent of her abilities are unknown, though she is able to hold up a large barrier, and falls asleep as a result.
146837: The late father of Reiji Kirihara and Shinji Kirihara. He was training both of his sons in swordsmanship, and was especially hard on Shinji for being the eldist.
146838: The demon that fell from Heaven that ravages his own kind. The immensely powerful mononoke that could rival Ragou in potential: Amagi. The so-called friend of Ragou, Amagi and him have had a long history dating back to the Edo period.
146839: One of the mononoke that was collaborating with Roren and Naruko. Tetsuwa is a full on brute that specializes in brawling. In the past, he was once a god that ruled over a mountain forest.
146840: A member of Black Cloak, one of Bureau's elite squads. Banri, partnered with Takeru Inui, often follow Touko Kusumi as bodyguards. Despite her small stature, Banri is a very capable bodyguard that can rival some mononoke.
146841: A gentleman that acts as Touko Kusumi's lieutenant. Banjuurou is, as expected, a kind gentleman that protects Touko. Though he usually acts as a chauffeur, he is easily capable of participating in combat.
146842: A member of Black Cloak, one of the Bureau's elite squads. Takeru gives off the vibe of a delinquent, though he is very much the opposite of one, being responsible and a pretty serious guy.
146843: An eerie looking mononoke outfitted like a beast that resides in Avidya Forest. Wielding a large scythe, Monjumaru exudes a frightening aura to unwelcome persons. Though he gives off such an aura, he isn't actually that bad. He simply protects the forest with Ibuki, his wife.
146844: For the most part, Ibuki is, in reality, a kind individual. So long as she may permanently reside in her forest, she is happy. Lest anything causes harm to anything in Avidya Forest, Ibuki will then harm them. Otherwise, she has no problem with humans and mononoke.
146845: A well known retired onmitsu and the lone grandfather of Jirou Azuma. Toshimasa Azuma, even with his old age, is still a very formidable onmitsu. Among the onmitsu that are a part of the Bureau, Toshimasa may be the strongest of them all.
146846: One of Amagi's many followers, Roren is a mononoke capable of masterful illusions. Compared to others of his kind, he isn't particularly powerful in a brawl; however, when using his illusions, he can enhance himself or cause disadvantages for others to gain the upper hand.
